snippet.title: You Have To Try This New Voice Party Game! (SCREW IT!)
snippet.description:
SCREW IT! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a very questionable TV game show. Bid on how many answers you can name. Call your friends' bluff. Shout SCREW IT! and make them prove it live on the mic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5228680/SCREW_IT/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer

Expect penalty cards, voice effects, Challenge Time minigames and Mr. Static judging every bad decision you make.

Wishlist SCREW IT! now on Steam.

Watch the Screw It! trailer to see if this new voice party game is right for your next group session. Discover how to play rounds like The Bid and Challenge Time with friends.

Screw It! is a 4-8 player voice party game available on Steam that brings a chaotic game show environment to your living room. The video showcases the core mechanics, demonstrating how you and your friends compete through verbal challenges and bidding wars. If you enjoy chaotic social games that rely on communication rather than just quick reflexes, this title offers a fresh twist on the genre.

Players rotate through distinct rounds such as Prove It, requiring quick thinking and vocal performance to outsmart opponents. Whether you are looking for a new game show party experience to host on your next game night or just want to see how the voice-based mechanics function in practice, this overview covers the essential gameplay loops you can expect.

#ScrewIt #PartyGame #IndieGame
